title: Efferon wants to eradicate the devastating toll of pediatric sepsis | TechCrunch
summary: Although Efferon makes absorbers for adults, Efferon NEO, its pediatric device developed specifically for young kids, is proving especially effective. Since children have a significantly lower circulating blood volume, they require medical devices engineered specifically for their physiology, according to Romashin.
